# Season Shelf 1.2.2

This update improves interface clarity and makes channel scan results easier to understand.

- Fixed search-group choices appearing aligned to the right.
- Show message, verified-file and review counts after channel scans, with clearer empty results.
- Automatically show Unverified files when a scan finds videos but cannot verify their metadata.
- Refined navigation, selected rows, download states, controls and scrollbars across light and dark themes.
- Added keyboard-accessible tooltips for icon controls and subtle transitions that respect reduced-motion preferences.
- Fixed the VS Code build task on Windows systems where PowerShell blocks npm.ps1.

## Installation

Windows: download the x64 setup installer below. Existing installed copies receive this update through the app updater.

macOS: download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. The build is unsigned and is not notarized.

Completed downloads, account settings and lifetime usage totals are preserved when updating.
